messages:
alex: quick handoff from evening shift — keeping this short. current state:
- incidents: INC-3456 (embed evictions) -> mitigated (rolled back kv-cache config to v2, eviction rate dropping).
- latency: noticed tail spikes on /generate in eu-west-1 around 20:30 UTC, traced to NFS read backlog on node pool-gpu-2.
- deploys: model-redwood-v2 canary paused after spike. PR #1234 blocked on perf signoff.
- followups: memory profiling job + run preflight checks at +1h.

commands I ran:
```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout pause deploy/model-redwood-v2-canary
kubectl -n infra exec -it pod/cache-ctrl -- ./tools/evict-monitor --reset-ttl=1800
# quick tail logs for the latency spike
kubectl -n inference logs --since=1h -l app=frontend | grep "read timeout" | tail -n 50\```

oncall-bot: Incident INC-3456 status updated to "mitigated" by alex at 21:14 UTC :white_check_mark:

tanya: thanks alex. did you leave the canary paused or unpaused? any reason to rollback the rollback?

alex: left canary paused. no rollback of the kv-cache rollback — that change looks stable so far. primary reason for pause is to validate perf baseline after cache change.

rik: for INC-3456 — did we change eviction thresholds or just TTL? curious if this will affect cold-start P99 for embeddings.

alex: increased TTL to 30m and lowered max_items to 200k (trial). eviction rate metric (kv_cache.evictions/sec) is down ~80% in the last 20m. cold-start p99 for embeddings is up ~10ms right after cache warm but back to baseline after warm.

maria: i'll take midnight check. i'll run the quick health-check script and confirm evictions + p99 in eu-west-1. leaving note here when done.

tanya: added link to runbook in rotation doc and updated the rotation note: "pause canary -> monitor 30m -> proceed to gradual rollout if stable" :thumbsup:

alex: thanks team. next steps for whoever's on next shift: 1) verify eviction rate stays low for 2h, 2) unpause canary only after perf tests pass, 3) if latency spikes reappear, pin model to redwood-v1 and open INC-XXXX with logs. leaving full debug snippet in the runbook.

maria: quick-check command i'll run:```bash
./scripts/health-check --region eu-west-1 --check evictions,p99,kv-usage --output short
```

maria: running now, will report back in this thread.

oncall-bot: Reminder: please attach any post-shift notes to the rotation doc (https://redwood.internal/rotation/eng-oncall)

tanya: noted. good handoff, alex. :raised_hands:
